::: {#def-confidence-coefficient}
#### Confidence coefficient

The **confidence coefficient** of an interval $\cintf{X}$ for a parameter $\param$
is the infimum over $\param$ of its
[coverage probability](#def-coverage-probability),
$\inf_{\param} \Prunder{\param}{\param \in \cintf{X}}$.

Source: [@CaseBerg01, Definition 9.1.5].
:::
